data.description: The Shoulder Press Double has two seats with handles above shoulder height, so two users can press upward side by side. Each user sits with the back against the rest, pushes the handles up and lets them come down slowly, working the shoulders, upper back and arms against body weight. It is a common pick for corporate campuses and college gyms, where users train in pairs before or after work. The Shoulder Press Double comes in Play Orange with orange seats as part of our Fun Fitness range. We confirm the footprint and the warranty on this unit in writing with your quote. Our standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, and we will confirm cover for this machine. Ask us for a quote.

items.pText: The Shoulder Press Double has two seats with handles above shoulder height, so two users can press upward side by side. Each user sits with the back against the rest, pushes the handles up and lets them come down slowly, working the shoulders, upper back and arms against body weight. It is a common pick for corporate campuses and college gyms, where users train in pairs before or after work. The Shoulder Press Double comes in Play Orange with orange seats as part of our Fun Fitness range. We confirm the footprint and the warranty on this unit in writing with your quote. Our standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, and we will confirm cover for this machine. Ask us for a quote.

Each pressing arm swings on a pivot above the seat, so the pivots and seat bolts need checks during routine service. The double frame is installed self-standing or grouted after a site visit. Keep the area above and in front of both seats clear of low branches.
